sidebarCard.whatsappMessage: Hi! I have a question about Hamriyah Free Zone.

items.q: What is the typical registration timeframe for a company in Hamriyah Free Zone?
items.a: Company formation can be completed within 3-5 working days provided all documentation is in order and you have a clear business activity. We manage documentation and approvals faster.

items.q: Can foreign investors have 100% ownership of a company in HFZA?
items.a: Yes. HFZA allows 100% foreign ownership — no local sponsor required.

items.q: What types of licenses are available in Hamriyah Free Zone?
items.a: Commercial, Service, Industrial, E-commerce licenses, and Freelance Permits — each tailored to different business activities.

items.q: Is Hamriyah Free Zone a good option for industrial businesses?
items.a: Absolutely. HFZA is famous for industrial manufacturing with ready-to-use warehouses, custom plots, and access to Sharjah's airports and port facilities.

items.q: What makes HFZA a better option compared to other free zones?
items.a: Low setup costs, sophisticated logistics infrastructure, flexible business terms, and prime location on global trade routes.

items.q: Can I apply for visas through HFZA for myself and my employees?
items.a: Yes. HFZA provides streamlined immigration for investors and employees — investor visas, employment visas, and family sponsorship.

items.q: Do I have to contract for physical office space in HFZA?
items.a: No. Flexi-desk options are available — a low-cost alternative with legal business address and visa eligibility.

items.q: What documents are required to register?
items.a: Passport copies, passport-size photos, proposed business names, and an active email/contact number.

items.q: Does HFZA support online or digital business models?
items.a: Yes. HFZA supports e-commerce, digital services, and online business models with appropriate licensing.

items.q: Will you support me after my license is issued?
items.a: Yes. We provide ongoing support — visa processing, PRO services, renewals, compliance, and digital business growth.
